nome_jp: メッサー・シュミット
testo:
Mach Fighter
Double Breaker
■ While battling, this creature gets +4000 power.
■ Whenever this creature wins a battle, draw a card. If it was the first battle this creature won during this turn, you may choose one of your opponent's creatures. This creature and that creature battle.
